currentComparison.programEligibilityReason: These assertions constrain program/currency/product or transaction eligibility, not the descriptive classification of an Appendix F source row. WEX OTR unlisted-product rejection requires its own program category authority; source-table presence does not satisfy it.
currentComparison.otherReason: Every other current rule is explicitly classified in the preceding semantic review as field representation, lifecycle, entry/track, expiry, retry, amount, crypto, receipt, configuration or companion-data behavior. None asserts the per-row Appendix F descriptive classification. This finite-universe comparison does not imply absence of other unreviewed legacy obligations.

companionComparison.reason: Petroleum Appendix B membership is not individual ATL105 Appendix F descriptive classification. Codes 541-549 are present only in ATL105 in the pinned inventories; keep source authorities separate.
A classified code can still be prohibited by a fleet service/restriction indicator. Fuel/maintenance interpretation is program-specific and is not approved by row membership.
A product-list uniqueness invariant compares multiple entries; a single source-row classification cannot establish it. Visa's all-product extension remains unresolved.
Product presence and sum reconciliation concern transaction content, not the source assignment or class of a code; tax/discount accounting cannot be inferred.
Chip restrictions and offline/online product limits remain additional Voyager conditions; a source-row match neither proves chip permission nor supplies issuer limits.

These explicitly enumerated companion statements concern eligibility, card identification/configuration, account/track/entry, prompting, receipt, expiry, amount bounds, CVM, terminal capability, evidence retention or chip lifecycle. They do not assert Appendix F row descriptions/classification. Shared product-related context or a prompt field is not equivalent to this metadata assertion.

conflict.meaning: The overview ends FSA/HRA at 894 and begins proprietary reservation at 895; the detailed tables assign 895/896 and begin reservation at 897. Preserve both claims; do not silently reject or accept disputed codes.
